question: Team Rest of India won Irani Cup in 2023. Irani Cup was hosted in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is **Madhya Pradesh**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Team Rest of India** won the Irani Cup in 2023.
 
• The Irani Cup is a prestigious domestic cricket tournament in India.
 
• In 2023, the tournament was hosted in the state of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The Irani Cup generally features a match between the previous season's Ranji Trophy winners and the Rest of India team.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Madhya Pradesh - The state where the 2023 Irani Cup was hosted.
 
 

 Option 2
 West Bengal - Not the host state for the 2023 Irani Cup.
 
 

 Option 3
 Bihar - Not the host state for the 2023 Irani Cup.
 
 

 Option 4
 Uttar Pradesh - Not the host state for the 2023 Irani Cup.
